name: Google Maps
summary: Disable location history, use Incognito for sensitive routes, and limit OS-level location access.

settings.name: Location History / Timeline
settings.impact: Google Maps Timeline records every place you visit with timestamps. This data has been used in geofence warrants to identify people near crime scenes.
settings.source: SafeToolsHub Google Privacy Guide; Google Maps Privacy documentation

settings.name: Web & App Activity (Location)
settings.impact: Even with Location History off, Web & App Activity continues saving location data from Maps searches. Both must be disabled — a gap most users miss.
settings.source: WhatIsMyIP: 'Google Maps and Your Privacy'; SafeToolsHub Google Privacy Guide

settings.name: Location Permission (OS Level)
settings.impact: Granting 'Always' lets Maps track your position continuously in the background. 'While Using' restricts tracking to active navigation only.
settings.source: EFF Opt-Out October; Google Maps Privacy Help

settings.name: Incognito Mode
settings.impact: Incognito mode prevents searches and routes from being saved to your Timeline, useful when navigating to medical facilities, places of worship, or other sensitive destinations.
settings.source: Google Maps Help documentation; makeuseof.com Google Maps Privacy Guide

settings.name: Delete Existing Location History
settings.impact: Turning off future tracking does not remove past data. Google stores years of precise location records that can reveal home address, work, and medical visits.
